# Elecrow CrowPanel ESP32 5.79" e-paper display

`sim/third_party/crowpanel.json` is a mesh derived from Elecrow's 3D model of the CrowPanel ESP32 5.79" E-paper HMI Display
(`3D file/CrowPanel ESP32 5.79” E-paper HMI Display.stp` in
[Elecrow-RD/CrowPanel-ESP32-5.79-E-paper-HMI-Display-with-272-792](https://github.com/Elecrow-RD/CrowPanel-ESP32-5.79-E-paper-HMI-Display-with-272-792)).
It was tessellated with occt-import-js (`tools/tess.js`), grouped by material and quantised to 0.01 mm (`tools/pack.py`), and is
used only to show the display in the simulator and to check the enclosure's fit around it. The original STEP is not included.

Elecrow publishes the model in that repository without a license statement. The model and anything derived from it remain
Elecrow's; it is not covered by FaderDeck's licenses.
